message.content: {"verdict": "gap", "citations": ["rbi-13155"], "evidence": [{"doc_id": "rbi-13155", "quote": "Card-issuers shall seek One Time Password (OTP) based consent from the cardholder for activating a credit card, if the same has not been activated by the customer for more than 30 days from the date of issuance. If no consent is received for activating the card, card-issuers shall close the credit card account without any cost to the customer within seven working days from date of seeking confirmation from the customer."}], "confidence": 0.9, "rationale": "The clause mandates seeking OTP consent for activating an unactivated credit card after 30 days, but omits the mandatory requirement to close the credit card account within seven working days if no consent is received."}
